config.attention: one head, Q=nonaffine layer-norm of frozen causal yield context, K=V=projected text tokens
config.attention_formula: masked softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(64)); control uses masked uniform weights
config.direction: mean endpoint logistic loss softplus(-sign(target)*forecast/10bp); nonzero targets only
config.gate: optional frozen-ungated residual wrapper; separate matched train-only chronological OOF gate per arm
config.selection: all models and teachers fixed final epoch; no validation tuning
config.text_stage: both arms full-path Smooth L1 plus weight-1 directional objective at days 1/3/5

paired_bootstrap_sensitivity.limits: Exploratory repeated validation; no temporal blocking, no independent seeds, no correction across contrasts, not a confirmatory interval.
paired_bootstrap_sensitivity.sampling: 20,000 draws of 12 validation statements with replacement; each paired difference is averaged over fixed seeds first; linear 2.5/97.5 percentiles.
paired_bootstrap_sensitivity.units: basis points; positive means left is worse
